composition_variation: Create a vivid peaceful anime illustration of adult Son Goku eating breakfast on a mountain cabin porch. Preserve his iconic tall spiky black hair, bright dark eyes, and open cheerful expression. He wears an orange short-sleeve casual shirt over a blue undershirt, comfortable navy trousers, and simple shoes. Seated at a small low table, he looks happily at a steaming rice bowl with chopsticks resting beside it. Use pine-green slopes, amber wood, crisp turquoise morning air, and a broad quiet sky. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
